content.text: The Real Reason This Problem Exists

The real reason this problem exists is the lack of base-layer infrastructure that supports sovereign digital commerce. Most platforms, such as Stripe and PayPal, have restrictions that prevent creators in certain countries from using their services. This leaves a significant gap in the market, where creators are unable to sell their digital products to international buyers. The absence of reliable payment processing infrastructure is a major obstacle to the growth of digital commerce in these regions.
Why the Obvious Fixes Do Not Work

The obvious fixes, such as using workarounds or alternative payment platforms, do not work because they are often unreliable, expensive, or have significant limitations. For example, some platforms may charge high fees or have strict requirements for verification, which can be difficult for creators in certain countries to meet. Additionally, these workarounds may not provide the same level of security and reliability as a base-layer infrastructure solution.
The Infrastructure That Solves It at the Base Layer

The infrastructure that solves this problem at the base layer is a combination of cloud hosting, backend logic, and crypto payment processing. For example, using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This infrastructure provides a secure, reliable, and scalable solution for creators to sell their digital products to international buyers.
